snippet.title: SIBIR - the furniture is ALIVE | gameplay reveal
snippet.description:
Sibir is a co-op survival horror game for 1-4 players. An abandoned Soviet bunker where the furniture is alive and hunting you!

The mundane objects of the K-7 facility come alive and chase you. Scavenge parts and craft what keeps you alive in the dark

Stay Tuned! Full game will be out on October 26th

Wishlist SIBIR on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3118840/Sibir/
